failures.observation: The fixed Linux test mount denied execution of the tiny test oracle. The runner retained a lie_warmup_failure with spawn EACCES and zero workload calls.
failures.resolution: Allow executable fixtures on the CI temporary mount, then rerun the same tests and frozen scientific inputs.

failures.observation: The first Linux failure reported an assertion before writing its diagnostic artifacts.
failures.resolution: Save terminal files, process logs and mount flags before test assertions. The next failed run exposed the exact cause.

failures.observation: A test process exited with code zero while its detached child was still alive. The controller found, stopped and reaped the child, then classified the process as failed.
failures.resolution: Use Linux child adoption around serial runtime steps and include cleanup in the final process status.
